title: YTM solver bug in bond-pricer – need your repro
subject: YTM solver bug in bond-pricer – need your repro
snippet: Hi Sruly, I traced the YTM solver bug in bond-pricer. The Newton-Raphson iteration diverges for bonds priced below 60 where the starting guess is the coupon rate. In your Bayview run, 7 of 412 bonds
